title: OneCoin Webinar - 21.04.2016
description: OneCoin Webinar hosted by Paul Smith - 21.04.2016.

asr.full_text: Hello from myself Paul Smith and welcome to this week's State of the Nation Broadcast for Thursday the 21 April. Our growth momentum continues with Global Membership past £1.8 Million and some 633 million WONcoins mined. My Regards to each and every one of you who are building YOUR Futures with WONcoin. AT WONcoin we LOVE Promotions. to each and every one of you who are building your futures with OneCoin. At OneCoin we love promotions and we know you love them also, so we are presenting all of you with a unique promotion all package codes activated between April the 18th that's last Monday ... and May the first ... a week Sunday ... we receive 10% more tokens! So get selling and building your business now as more tokens equals more coins! As I said last week, there's only one place to be in June at our exciting one coin global event in London, it's going to be awesome and a fitting milestone to the success of the business with top news presentations from global leaders and of course a keynote address from our CEO and founder Dr Ruja Ignatova. Look at the video promoting the event in your back-office of which there's a version with Chinese subtitles. Tickets are up for sale in the back office in the London event section and availability is limited and it's selling very very fast you must book your tickets in advance to attend the most anticipated event of the year. There are three different categories of tickets, bronze at a hundred euro, silver at a hundred and fifty euro and gold at two hundred euro. In order to show gratitude to our most dedicated supporters, we are giving all members with Diamond Rank above two free tickets for the event. And remember if you order 10 tickets from a category by the 1st of may 2016 you'll get a ticket free. We'll keep you up to date with all the information about the event and we're looking forward to seeing you all in london on June the 11th, 2016. Again, a strong reminder to all of you who bought a package or packages before our April price increase. All OneCoin package codes of these purchases will be valid only until Saturday, April the 30th, this year. Afterwards, they cannot be activated more! So make sure you activate any OneCoin package codes you bought, by April 30th. If you're a new member Of The OneCoin Family The Starter Bonus Is A Great Way To Get Your Business off to a flying start take advantage of our startup bonus within the 30 days after the date of registration registration not the acquiring of the package you're eligible to receive the starter bonus to qualify for a start of bonus you need to have 5,500 BV collected out of personal sales within that 30 day period. Another great way to drive your business is by collecting free package codes, codes that you can use yourself or utilise to motivate others in your business. business! Our FREE package promotion continues with you able to get a €27,500 package for free. That of course is the Infinity package. If you bank 8 Infinity codes, you will get 1 Infinity code free. If you bank 10 Premium codes, you will get one Premium code free if you bank ten Tycoon codes you'll get one Tycoon codes free and if you bank 6 Premium codes you will get 3 Pro Trader codes free. Also the 6 plus 1 Champion, The Cone Vegas Promotion and its extra Champion Code gives you an extra Champion code. If you bank in six champion codes, do remember in order to get the free package or packages you need to be clear in your communication with the accounting department of the company. First, make sure that you've accumulated the right amount of code related to the specific package or packages to get the free promotion code or codes. Secondly report to the accounting department on all the codes you banked in in 1 payment. Remember to explain which codes correspond to which payments when you send the bank work. We would like to remind you all that the acceptable documents for proof of address are a utility bill, gas, water, electric, a letter from a bank statement, a document from the tax authority, documentation from a residential agency, a national ID card or passport if the address is shown. We do not accept the following types of documents as proof of address, mobile phone bills, driving licenses, courier receipts, documents issued by pension funds insurance agencies, Western Union, money gram, invoices from stores and Credit or Debit Card statements issued from store chains. Do remember that any KYC documents must be in English or written with Latin letters. Additionally, please bear in mind that you can continue to trade on the OneCoin exchange regardless of whether your status is PENDING, Conditionally Approved or Approved. Please check what your status is before uploading additional documents. More documents may only be needed if your status is DECLINED or incase you edit your user informational For the Menuprofile main information. Do ensure this because otherwise you may be charged twice in terms of translation etc. For our members in China, do note that if your documents are not translated to English, we'll do it for you, but we will charge you 15 euros from your cash account. For Chinese members with approved accounts, do note that in the case your uploaded documents have been translated and you being charged 15 euros, you can then use the COPI function to upload the same documents in your other accounts if you upload new KYC documents in an already approved and previously debited account you'll be charged again with the 15 euro translation fee if your documents have not been translated by a certified translator and appropriately signed and stamped for those of you who have seen won coin's rock star leaders carrie walrus and edu depeche in action it'll come as no surprise that these crazy guys have decided to do something even crazier together these two top leaders will take part in the fastest and weirdest race on the planet the world-famous Gumball 3000 rally where they'll test their skills against top race car drivers, celebrities, Forbes 500 entrepreneurs and even middle-eastern royal family members. Started in 1999 the Gumball 3000 is a luxury automotive road trip taking place every year and travelling a different 3 000 mi route. 1. The participants drive through capital cities in front of hundreds of thousands of fans and photographers as Gumball shunts up famous landmarks in each city where spectacular static car displays are hosted and documented by the world's press. Last year the luxury automobile roadtrip featured only 100 cars and drivers from 30 nations. Gumball's early 2000s founder Maximilian Cooper will lead the race across 7 European cities over the span of 7 days starting from Dublin on April 30 Edinburgh London, UK Prague ,Budapest, Hungary and finishing Bucharest ,Romania on May 7 If you are in those cities at the time Don't miss the chance to see the extraordinary and meet the One coin Team. Support the coin boys and the children Gumball 3000 is aiming to help. The more donations our team gets the better their starting position. Our european events continue with Novossibirska in Russia on this Friday, the 22nd of April, London in the UK on Saturday the 23rd and Lyon, France on Sunday the 24th. These are amazing opportunities to listen to the very best leaders on the planet who've built up huge and experience and knowledge in one coin and direct selling. For more information on the leadership training and presentation events please contact your upline, check our Facebook page or follow the news section on our official oneCoin website. Business at Home the global direct selling news and information organization keeps a running score on the reported earnings of leaders in the industry. As of April, OneCoin has the number one position in our very own legend, Uber. We have 15 entries of $1,000,000 per year and these entries collectively represent $100,000,000 of earnings per year. And remember these individuals represent only a part of our global leadership. We are a business that's only 18 months old and how are we going to look in 12 months time? And of course where will you be on this prestigious listing? As an international organisation devoted to empowering youth to achieve their potential, the One World Foundation has donated €10,382 to the American University in Bulgaria, the AUBG, in the spring of this year. Thanks to our generous support, two first-year students will have half of their tuition fees covered. The person behind our scholarship is our patron, Dr. Ruzsa Ignatova, a wonderfully successful business person and prominent philanthropist. In just a year, the foundation that she has set up has supported over 1000 youngsters from 12 countries around the world. Committed to encouraging accessible high quality education, we decided to create the Dr. Ruzsa Ignitova Scholarship for a first year student in financial need. I'm fortunate to have received many opportunities in life, so now the time has come for me to provide a young person with a chance to build their future." Dr. Ruža Ignatova said. Well, that brings this week's State of the Nation to an end, the business continues to drive ahead I'll be back next week to update you on all our progress hosted by myself Paul Smith. Visit the OneCoin webinars YouTube channel or the onecoin-sotn.com website. Until next week, all the best from the whole OneCoin team.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the webinar urges viewers to sell and build their business using a time-limited 10% token benefit, claiming that more tokens mean more coins. The video also requests KYC documents, but that is a separate operational step rather than the main offer.
